en: An inclined plane like a ramp reduces the lifting force needed by increasing the distance over which the force is applied.
Rubbing your hands together quickly generates heat because friction converts kinetic energy into thermal energy.
The Moon's gravitational pull causes Earth's ocean water to bulge outward, creating high and low tides.
Running an electric current through a copper wire coiled around an iron nail temporarily magnetizes the nail.
Rubbing a balloon on your hair transfers electrons to the balloon, giving it a negative charge that attracts neutral paper.
Light bends when it passes from air into water because it slows down, making a submerged pencil look broken.
Plucking a tight guitar string makes it vibrate rapidly, pushing air molecules to create sound waves that reach your ear.
Heat travels from a hot stove to a metal pot through conduction as fast-moving particles collide with slower ones.
A roller coaster at the top of a hill has maximum potential energy that converts to kinetic energy as it drops.
A single fixed pulley changes the direction of your pull, allowing you to lift a heavy bucket by pulling downward.
Dark-colored solar water heaters absorb radiant energy from the Sun and convert it into thermal energy to warm the water.
Blowing air across a flute's hole creates vibrating air columns, where shorter columns vibrate faster to produce higher-pitched sounds.
